scope: derivative-free scalar polynomial operator ring through engineering dimension six

construction.method: exact D5 symmetric-power plethysms followed by exact irrep-product singlet reduction

normalization_conventions.representation_metric: positive unit invariant Hermitian form on each compact Spin(10) irrep
normalization_conventions.isotypic_embeddings: orthonormal; ordered by D5 Dynkin label then exact plethysm copy index
normalization_conventions.singlet_Hom_basis: orthonormal; deterministic Susyno reduction order; first nonzero weight-lex coefficient positive real
normalization_conventions.Hermitian_conjugation: D5 chirality 4<->5, H<->Hb, D<->Db, S<->Sb, X<->Xb; conjugate sectors paired by equal ordered basis index
normalization_conventions.component_projection_boundary: component Clebsch expansion is canonical G2, not silently claimed by this G1 channel basis
